beats.text: Even that cleaner distinction is a way to organize observations, not a proven mechanism.

beats.text: The autopsy teaches readers to inspect the relation between claims, not only each claim alone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed idea names a tendency toward excessively coherent accounts under certain conditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It does not require a model to feel pressure or possess an intention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Several processes could contribute, including prediction, training, conversational framing, and evaluation incentives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book separates the observed behavior from these possible explanations of its origin.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also allows that existing concepts may already account for the pattern.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That caution is central because the book could otherwise repeat the very error it studies.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Coherence is valuable when it helps organize evidence without erasing meaningful differences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The difficulty is deciding when synthesis has crossed into unjustified smoothing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines this boundary in conversation, summarization, and collaborative writing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A summary can become more readable while losing the disagreement that made sources informative.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Accepting a user's premises can strengthen a weak bridge without inventing an isolated fact.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These extensions show why the opening case matters beyond one mistaken conversation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The measurement chapters ask what a serious test of the proposed pattern would require.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A benchmark would need source material, a task, and the resulting account.
